name: Fumitsuki Fumika
source:
A college student living alone. She loves books regardless of genre. Therefore, her knowledge is somewhat biased, coming only from books and the Internet. 

She is shy, but she is interested in the master of the coffee shop. 

[From [url=https://www.ammolite-game.com/amml_035/top.html#link_character]official site[/url]]
